people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: This thing became known to Mordecai, who informed Esther the queen; and Esther informed the king in Mordecai’s name.
translations.bsb: When Mordecai learned of the plot, he reported it to Queen Esther, and she informed the king on Mordecai’s behalf.
translations.kjv: And the thing was known to Mordecai, who told it unto Esther the queen; and Esther certified the king thereof in Mordecai's name.
translations.asv: And the thing became known to Mordecai, who showed it unto Esther the queen; and Esther told the king thereof in Mordecai's name.
